page.overview:
What is Peacekeeping of Parliock?

The Peacekeeping of Parliock was a conflict that was fought at some point prior to the Clone Wars which involved the Jedi Order. During the Clone Wars, the architect droid Huyang recalled the Peacekeeping while telling a class of Jedi younglings about conflicts the Jedi had been involved in.
